items.title: Why Russia Violated Every Ceasefire for 12 Years, Even Those They Proposed
items.description: Kyiv Post scrutinizes 17 ceasefires starting with the Kremlin’s initial invasion of Ukraine in February 2014. Since the first one on June 20, 2014, all have been violated by the Russians. Here, Kyiv Post covers why Russia does so and what Ukraine and its allies could do.

items.title: Lebanon war leaves families foraging for food despite ceasefire

items.title: After massive Israeli attacks, how is Hezbollah still fighting?
items.description: Since late 2024, and now as part of the U.S.-Israel war against Iran, Lebanon’s Tehran-backed Hezbollah militia has been the target of powerful and persistent Israeli attacks. So, how is it that it keeps on fighting, even intensifying its own attacks on Israel?
